name: Wacky Races
summary: Arcade racing game featuring the cast and vehicles from Hanna-Barbera's classic show. Instead of utilizing laps, players compete on a single, long track with checkpoints that extend time. Random power-ups are granted periodically by pullling on the physical lever of the machine. Progress can be made between play sessions through provided password saves. Tracks and racers can be swapped and unlocked using in-game currency.
